title: State which runtime bytes the two c48_long receipts bind
summary: The locomotion guide said scripts/play.py accepts either compatibility receipt. Both receipts bind the runtime bytes of source 717548d5, and the loader accepts a receipt only when the running runtime files match it; after the Ruff reformat of the runtime merged (PR 86), 11 of the 50 bound files still match main. The guide now says so and that the reformatted runtime's certified receipt is pending. No evidence file changes.
